_comment: Real tools/call argument shapes captured live from code-review-graph 2.3.7 (MCP serverInfo.version=3.4.4) via the initialize+tools/call probe documented in the sprint-4 briefing. Each key is a captured fixture tool name; the value is the exact `arguments` object sent in that capture.

sprint6QueryCaptures._comment: Sprint-6 live captures (code-review-graph 2.3.7, MCP serverInfo 3.4.4) mapping bober's 4 QueryPatterns to query_graph_tool. Paths sanitized WORK->/repo. callers/callees/tests_for require a qualified_name target (bare names are status:'ambiguous'); imports/importers take a file path. Sample project: src/math_utils.py {add,multiply,Calculator.compute}, src/main.py {run,helper,another}, tests/test_math_utils.py {test_add,test_multiply}.

sprint6DirectionMap.callers_of: query_graph_tool pattern='callers_of', target=NodeRef.id (qualified_name) -> results[] via crToNodeRef  [INBOUND]
sprint6DirectionMap.callees_of: query_graph_tool pattern='callees_of', target=NodeRef.id (qualified_name) -> results[] via crToNodeRef  [OUTBOUND]
sprint6DirectionMap.imports_of: query_graph_tool pattern='importers_of' (NOT 'imports_of'!), target=NodeRef.file -> results[].importer as module NodeRefs  [dependents, matches tokensave file_dependents]
sprint6DirectionMap.tests_for: query_graph_tool pattern='tests_for', target=NodeRef.id (qualified_name, NOT file!) -> results[] test-symbol rows via crToNodeRef
